Bronx, New York

JLuna is a dark industrial techno producer and DJ from the Bronx, New York. With over 17 years in electronic music, he has developed a sound built on rhythmic precision, massive low-end engineering, and hypnotic tension — techno designed for professional sound systems and the hours when cities stop pretending.

His productions operate between 130 and 137 BPM, rooted in peak-time driving techno with the raw, architectural textures of the underground Berlin warehouse scene. The focus is always the same: a relentless kick and bass pocket that commands a dancefloor without clutter, layered with cold, metallic atmospheres that feel less like software and more like sound bouncing off concrete. Dark, physical, and precise.

Performing behind a signature gold mask, JLuna's identity is as deliberate as his music. He has performed at Pacha NYC and continues to push his sound through releases on Addictive Sounds, including his debut RE: Establishing Contact (2026).

His sound bridges the mainstage energy of labels like KNTXT and Drumcode with the raw darkness of the underground — built for DJs who need tools, not moments.
